entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer and planeswalker of the Gatewatch who kills her third demon, Razaketh, and devours him with undead crocodiles.

entities.name: Razaketh
entities.description: A reptilian demon who holds a contract on Liliana's soul and can control her body, killed at the Luxa River after bringing about the Hours.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A telepathic planeswalker of the Gatewatch who speaks in Liliana's mind and breaks Razaketh's control, and is horrified by her revenge.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker of the Gatewatch who shields Liliana with his invulnerability and wounds Razaketh with his sural.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker of the Gatewatch who burns Razaketh.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker of the Gatewatch who summons elementals from the riverbank.

entities.name: The Raven Man
entities.description: A voice in Liliana's mind that tells her she is free only if she kills each of her demons.

entities.name: Kothophed
entities.description: A demon who held a contract on Liliana's soul and was killed by her.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon who held a contract on Liliana's soul and was killed by her.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon whose arrival the Gatewatch prepares to ambush; Razaketh's bloodspell sets his Hours in motion.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: The group of planeswalkers who come to Liliana's aid and then discuss how to prepare for Bolas.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: A relic Liliana carries at her side but chooses not to use against Razaketh.

entities.name: The Luxa
entities.description: The river that Razaketh has turned to blood, where Liliana is forced to wade and later raises dead animals.

entities.name: The Necropolis
entities.description: The structure beyond the Gate to the Afterlife near where Razaketh waits.

entities.name: Gate to the Afterlife
entities.description: The gate opened at the Hours, atop which Razaketh stood.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: The city of Amonkhet to which the Gatewatch returns.

entities.name: The Hours
entities.description: The sorcerous chain reaction that Razaketh's bloodspell set in motion to herald Nicol Bolas's return.

entities.name: Curse of Wandering
entities.description: The curse that raises the dead on Amonkhet, which takes hold of the crocodiles after Liliana releases them.

entities.name: Nissa's Elemental
entities.description: A massive elemental of sand and well water that Nissa raises from the riverbank to fight Razaketh.

events.summary: Liliana waits at the bloody Luxa and contacts Jace in her mind as Razaketh calls out for her.
events.quote: Jace? Can you hear me?

events.summary: Razaketh scans the crowd and Liliana finds her hand moving involuntarily.
events.quote: The movement of her hand had been . . . involuntary.

events.summary: Razaketh spots Liliana and the Gatewatch arrive, bruised from the arena.
events.quote: Liliana saw the rest of the Gatewatch arrive.

events.summary: Razaketh commands Liliana to come to him, and her body wades into the river of blood against her will; Chandra and Nissa are repelled by necromantic energy.
events.quote: her body waded forward into the river of blood.

events.summary: Liliana is forced beneath the surface of the blood river, and the Raven Man tells her she can only survive if she kills the demon.
events.quote: You are only free if you kill each of your demons, Liliana.

events.summary: Liliana's body swims itself across to the Necropolis bank, where Razaketh stands smugly above her.
events.quote: She had crossed the river and crawled onto the opposite bank.

events.summary: Razaketh toys with Liliana, making her kneel, nod and bark, and tells her he has fulfilled a friend's assignment.
events.quote: I love a dog who comes when she is called.

events.summary: Liliana regains her speech and tells Razaketh he has five minutes to live, then counts down to stall until her allies arrive.
events.quote: You have five more minutes to live,

events.summary: Chandra engulfs Razaketh in fire at Liliana's signal, and he rams her into the Necropolis wall.
events.quote: a jet of fire engulfed the demon.

events.summary: Razaketh dislocates Liliana's shoulder and silences her until Nissa's elemental breaks his concentration.
events.quote: A massive elemental emerged, its body forming from the banks of the river.

events.summary: Razaketh stops Liliana's breathing and paralyzes her as Chandra takes aim at him.
events.quote: She tried to suck in air, but her diaphragm was completely still.

events.summary: Gideon, camouflaged by Jace, slashes Razaketh's back with his sural, freeing Liliana's breath and shielding her with his invulnerability.
events.quote: carving three thick lines in Razaketh's back.

events.summary: Jace breaks Razaketh's control over Liliana's mind.
events.quote: Got him, move fast,

events.summary: Liliana draws the Chain Veil but puts it away, choosing to defeat Razaketh with her own power.
events.quote: Let the demon witness what terror she could wield all on her own.

events.summary: Liliana raises the dead animals of the river against Razaketh and blasts him down.
events.quote: a menagerie of death spilled up and out of the river of blood.

events.summary: Liliana possesses two dozen dead crocodiles and devours Razaketh, killing him.
events.quote: her two dozen selves consumed the last of the demon Razaketh.

events.summary: Jace is horrified as Liliana laughs and relishes the killing, and he tells her to stop.
events.quote: Liliana, that's enough

events.summary: Liliana releases the crocodiles, which swim away reanimated by the Curse of Wandering.
events.quote: The Curse of Wandering had taken hold.

events.summary: Liliana tells Jace she ate Razaketh and that only one demon remains; Jace does not answer.
events.quote: And now there's just one more.

events.summary: Gideon, Nissa and Chandra approach coldly, and Nissa warns that the bloodspell began a chain reaction that sets the Hours in motion.
events.quote: The Hours' that herald Nicol Bolas's return needed to be set in motion by the demon.

events.summary: The Gatewatch resolves to find a vantage to ambush Bolas, and the others return to Naktamun, regarding Liliana coldly.
events.quote: Let us seek a better vantage to prepare for Nicol Bolas's arrival,

events.summary: Jace tells Liliana he will not stand by if she loses control like that again.
events.quote: I'm not going to stand by if you lose it like that again.

relations.quote: her two dozen selves consumed the last of the demon Razaketh.
